name: What questions should I ask a custom kitchen contractor before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a custom kitchen contractor before hiring them?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a custom kitchen contractor before hiring them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a custom kitchen contractor, homeowners should ask detailed questions that reveal how the team manages real projects, not just how they sell them. Important questions include whether they have completed similar kitchens in comparable homes, who handles permits and inspections, how they manage change orders, what is included in the estimate, and how they deal with hidden conditions once demolition starts. It is also smart to ask who will be on site, how communication works, what the expected schedule looks like, and how warranty or punch-list items are handled after completion. For a luxury kitchen, ask whether they coordinate directly with appliance vendors, cabinet fabricators, stone suppliers, and finish trades. The answers should be specific, not vague. A contractor who is comfortable with custom work will explain the process clearly and identify likely risks before the job begins. That level of clarity usually predicts a smoother build.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar projects, permit handling, timeline, allowances, change orders, warranty coverage, and who manages the work day to day. The best contractor will give clear answers and explain how they handle hidden issues and product delays.
